newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF buys 105,000T of Argentine corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF buys 105,000T of Argentine corn.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperative Federation said on Friday it bought a total of 105,000 tonnes of Argentine feed corn and passed on another corn tender of 52,500 tonnes.
An official with the federation said it had initially invited a total of 157,500 tonnes of corn originating from the United States and Argentina.
The official said the federation divided the total amount into three lots, each of 52,500 tonnes.
The first was awarded to Cargill at $159.75 per tonne, C&F, with shipment for April 16-May 5.
The second was awarded to Peavey at $158.05 per tonne, C&F, with shipment for May 26-June 14. The third was passed on due to high bids.
Arrival ports were set for Inchon, Pusan, Ulsan and Kunsan.
Deliveries were set for June 10 for the first and July 20 for the second.
